mapper.select: SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_no, e.login_id, e.password_hash, e.employee_name, e.email, e.department_id, d.department_name, e.active, e.login_fail_count, e.locked_until, e.last_login_at, e.version FROM employee e JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE e.login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT r.role_code FROM employee_role er JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = er.role_id WHERE er.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND r.active = TRUE ORDER BY r.role_code

SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_no, e.login_id, e.employee_name, e.email, e.department_id, d.department_name, e.active, e.login_fail_count, e.locked_until, e.last_login_at, e.created_at, e.updated_at, e.version FROM employee e JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId}
SELECT er.employee_id, r.role_id, r.role_code, r.role_name FROM employee_role er JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = er.role_id WHERE er.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY r.role_code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE email = #{email} AND employee_id != #{employeeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee ( employee_no, login_id, password_hash, employee_name, email, department_id, active, login_fail_count, locked_until, last_login_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, version ) VALUES ( #{employee.employeeNo}, #{employee.loginId}, #{employee.passwordHash}, #{employee.employeeName}, #{employee.email}, #{employee.departmentId}, #{employee.active}, 0, NULL, NULL, #{actorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET employee_name = #{employeeName}, email = #{email}, department_id = #{departmentId}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE employee SET active = #{active}, updated_by = #{command.actorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE employee_id = #{command.employeeId} AND version = #{command.version}

UPDATE employee SET login_fail_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND version = #{version}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) FROM employee e JOIN employee_role er ON er.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = er.role_id WHERE e.active = TRUE AND r.active = TRUE AND r.role_code = #{roleCode}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM department) AS total_departments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM department WHERE active = TRUE) AS active_departments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee) AS total_employees, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE active = TRUE) AS active_employees, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until > #{now}) AS locked_employees, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `role` WHERE active = TRUE) AS active_roles
